## Personality

Milty Boulter holds a deep sense of pride in his mother. This admiration stems from the common belief among others that she possesses the remarkable resourcefulness needed to scrape together a living even under the hardest conditions.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0019)_

## Traits

- proud of his mother  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0019)</sub>

## History

Milty Boulter is a young student who attended school for a year before [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) enrolled, viewing himself as quite a man of the world. He sits next to [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) in class and previously attended the funeral of his cousin, Jane Ellen, alongside his mother.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), +60 more_
